shots.image: Night, alley behind a warehouse: the burglar stands inside a big open dumpster holding up a large blue site blueprint with a triumphant grin, papers flying around him.
shots.animate: He unfolds the blueprint, grins widely, papers flutter around him.

shots.image: Day, Gérard happily carries a huge pile of old papers and binders out of the office toward a big dumpster.
shots.animate: Gérard waddles with the pile, dumps it into the dumpster and dusts off his hands.

shots.image: Close-up from inside a dumpster looking up: papers falling in, a blue site blueprint, a list, a schedule with colored blocks, Gérard's face above smiling. No readable text.
shots.animate: The papers tumble down into the dumpster one after another.

shots.image: Night, alley: the burglar's legs stick out of the dumpster as he digs inside, Biscotte the fat orange tabby cat sitting on the dumpster lid, watching unimpressed.
shots.animate: The burglar digs, legs kicking, papers fly out; the cat watches and flicks its tail.

shots.image: Night, the burglar sits on the edge of the dumpster reading the blue blueprint with a flashlight, eyes sparkling, rubbing his chin.
shots.animate: He traces a path on the blueprint with his finger, his eyes widen, he smiles slyly.

shots.image: Night, the burglar walks confidently toward a side door of the warehouse, reading the unfolded blueprint like a tourist with a map.
shots.animate: He walks confidently while checking the map, then opens the side door and slips in.

shots.image: Day, office: Inès feeds papers into a paper shredder, thin strips falling out into the bin, confident nod.
shots.animate: Inès feeds the papers into the shredder, strips pour out, she nods with satisfaction.

shots.image: Day, office: Gérard enthusiastically shredding a tiny shopping list and a birthday card, Inès standing behind him with a raised eyebrow.
shots.animate: Gérard happily shreds paper after paper; Inès raises an eyebrow and shakes her head.
